units.source_text: 有时候,他将脱下的海军学校制服,还有裤子、紧身白衬衣都挂在白漆栅栏上……

en.t: Sometimes, he would hang his discarded naval academy uniform, along with his trousers and tight white shirt, on the white-painted fence...

units.source_text: 这些衣服紧挨花丛，散发出一段年轻人的汗臭。

en.t: The clothes lay close against the flower beds, giving off the smell of a young man's sweat for a while.

units.source_text: 蜜蜂误将这些闪烁着白光的衬衣当做花儿，飞落在上面歇息。

en.t: Bees mistook the white gleam of the shirts for flowers, flew down onto them, and rested there.

units.source_text: 饰有金丝缎的制幅挂在一栅栏上，恍如端正地深戴在他的头上一样。

en.t: His cap, trimmed with gold braid, hung on one fence post, looking just as if it were sitting properly and deeply on his head.

units.source_text: 他接受低班同学的挑战，到体育场后面的摔跤场去比赛相扑了。

en.t: He had accepted a challenge from the lower-class students and gone to the wrestling ring behind the gymnasium to compete in sumo.
